abstract: Genome-wide association studies (GWAS) have identified disease-associated loci, but linking these signals to molecular mechanisms remains difficult because of linkage disequilibrium and context-dependent genetic regulation. CellColocDB is a disease- and window-centred resource integrating GWAS-QTL colocalization across bulk, sorted-cell, and single-cell QTL datasets. The current release includes 2805 GWAS datasets covering 1201 diseases and traits and 40 516 GWAS windows, together with 23 QTL sources, 316 QTL contexts, and 89 842 molecular features. CellColocDB contains 3 572 118 coloc.abf results with PP.H4 > 0.5, including 1 609 418 with PP.H4 ≥ 0.8. Analyses are organized as GWAS dataset × GWAS window × QTL context × molecular feature tasks, allowing contexts and molecular features to be compared within the same GWAS region. coloc.abf is the primary colocalization analysis, with coloc-SuSiE and SMR/HEIDI providing complementary evidence where available. Task-specific ABF top SNPs are linked to CAUSALdb2 fine-mapping results from seven methods. Results are available through disease-, QTL context-, gene-, and locus-level views, with regional association tracks and matched variants, and can be queried by gene, genomic region, or GWAS window ID. CellColocDB is freely available at http://www.mulinlab.org/colocdb/.
